category_say.Data: Data concepts are where everything starts: raw data, time series, datasets, labels, and the knowledge graph itself.
category_say.Preprocessing: Preprocessing prepares data for models: cleaning, feature engineering and scaling.
category_say.Model: Models learn from the data: regression, forests, boosting, neural networks, L S T M, and language models.
category_say.Evaluation: Evaluation tells us if a model is good: cross validation, metrics, overfitting, tuning, and explainability.

nodes.label: Raw Data
nodes.desc: Unprocessed data from sensors, databases, APIs or files. Often noisy, incomplete and inconsistent.

nodes.label: Time Series
nodes.desc: Sensor or event data ordered in time (e.g. position, temperature, traffic). Typical use: forecasting and anomaly detection.

nodes.label: Dataset
nodes.desc: A curated table or tensor collection split into train, validation and test sets.

nodes.label: Labels
nodes.desc: Ground-truth targets used for supervised learning.

nodes.label: Data Cleaning
nodes.desc: Removing duplicates, fixing types, handling missing values and outliers.

nodes.label: Feature Engineering
nodes.desc: Creating informative inputs: lags, rolling statistics, ratios, encodings.

nodes.label: Scaling
nodes.desc: Standardisation or min-max scaling so features share a comparable range.

nodes.label: PCA
nodes.desc: Principal Component Analysis: linear dimensionality reduction that keeps maximum variance.

nodes.label: Embeddings
nodes.desc: Dense vectors that place similar items close together in a learned space.

nodes.label: Gradient Descent
nodes.desc: Iterative optimisation that follows the negative gradient of the loss.

nodes.label: Loss Function
nodes.desc: Measures how wrong predictions are: MSE for regression, cross-entropy for classification.

nodes.label: Linear Regression
nodes.desc: Baseline model: a weighted sum of features. Fast and interpretable.

nodes.label: Random Forest
nodes.desc: Ensemble of decision trees using bagging. Robust on tabular data.

nodes.label: Gradient Boosting
nodes.desc: Sequential trees that correct earlier errors (XGBoost, LightGBM). State of the art for tabular data.

nodes.label: Neural Network
nodes.desc: Layers of weighted units with non-linear activations, trained by back-propagation.

nodes.label: LSTM
nodes.desc: Recurrent network with gates that models long temporal dependencies.

nodes.label: Transformer
nodes.desc: Attention-based architecture. Basis of modern language models.

nodes.label: Large Language Model
nodes.desc: Transformer trained on huge text corpora. Can be run locally with Ollama.

nodes.label: K-Means
nodes.desc: Unsupervised clustering that assigns points to the nearest of k centroids.

nodes.label: Knowledge Graph
nodes.desc: Entities (nodes) and typed relations (edges). Used for reasoning and grounding AI answers.

nodes.label: GraphRAG
nodes.desc: Retrieval-augmented generation that pulls facts from a knowledge graph before the LLM answers.

nodes.label: Cross-Validation
nodes.desc: Repeated train/validation splits to estimate generalisation.

nodes.label: Metrics
nodes.desc: RMSE, MAE, accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC.

nodes.label: Overfitting
nodes.desc: Model memorises training data and fails on new data. Fight it with regularisation and more data.

nodes.label: Hyperparameter Tuning
nodes.desc: Searching learning rate, depth, regularisation via grid, random or Bayesian search.

nodes.label: Explainability
nodes.desc: SHAP and feature importance reveal why a model predicted something.

nodes.label: Python
nodes.desc: Main data science language. Libraries: pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch.

nodes.label: PyTorch
nodes.desc: Deep-learning framework with dynamic computation graphs.

nodes.label: Ollama
nodes.desc: Runs open LLMs locally on your laptop through a simple HTTP API.

nodes.label: Godot XR
nodes.desc: Game engine used here to visualise data and models in VR.

nodes.label: REST API
nodes.desc: Serves model predictions over HTTP.

nodes.label: Monitoring
nodes.desc: Tracks data drift and performance after deployment.

nodes.label: VR Dashboard
nodes.desc: Immersive 3D view of data, models and results.
